# Mohamed Sherif — محمد شريف

> Brand identity designer and branding educator based in Cairo, Egypt. He designs visual identities for companies in Egypt and the Gulf, and teaches designers through the BRAND-SET course, one-to-one mentoring sessions and free workshops. The site is in Arabic, with an English version on the same pages (?lang=en).

## Services
- [Brand Identity for Companies](https://mohamed-sherif.com/brand-identity/): visual identity design for companies and brands in Egypt and the Gulf, from the logo to the brand guidelines.

## Learning
- [BRAND-SET](https://mohamed-sherif.com/brand-set/): an online visual identity course of six lectures that follows the steps of real projects, from the client brief to the delivery files.
- [One : One Mentoring Session](https://mohamed-sherif.com/mentoring/): a 90-minute one-to-one session that assesses a designer's level across 8 axes, reviews one of their projects and ends with a practical plan.
- [Free Workshops](https://mohamed-sherif.com/workshops/): free recorded workshops, starting with "Branding The Big Picture".

## Tools
- [Mockup Builder](https://mohamed-sherif.com/mockup-builder/): a free tool that turns any logo into mockup prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini and Midjourney across every brand touch point.

## More
- [Home](https://mohamed-sherif.com/): selected work, about, services and student feedback.
